user_query: My company is planning to expand its sports betting services to international markets. Can you provide me with the tax rules for different countries using the getTaxRulesV2 API? Additionally, I would like to get a list of all available games and their subgames using the getAllGames API. It would be helpful if the response includes the game names, subgame names, and priority headers for each game.

TaskList.description: Retrieve tax rules for different countries related to sports betting services.
Get a list of all available games and their subgames along with priority headers.
